flavor_texts: The world watches. History holds its breath.
Every decision leaves a scar on the timeline.
Intelligence is power. Power is responsibility.
The clock ticks. The crisis deepens.
From this room, empires rise and fall.
There are no clean hands in this business. Only cleaner ones.
The map on the wall is a lie. The truth is in the margins.
We do not make history. We prevent it from happening to us.
Another week. Another line crossed somewhere in the dark.
Sleep is a luxury. Clarity is a necessity.
The cables don't stop. The world doesn't pause.
What they don't know is our only advantage.
Every ally is a future liability. Every enemy is a future opportunity.
The crisis is always now. The solution is always almost.
Control is an illusion we maintain through constant vigilance.
Behind every war is a conversation that failed.
Data without wisdom is just noise at scale.
The quiet weeks are the ones that scare me most.
We are the last line before the line that doesn't hold.
History will declassify us eventually. Until then—work.
Trust no one completely. Doubt no one entirely.
The world is not ending. It is reconfiguring. We are the configuration.
In crises, the decisive act is usually the least visible one.
There is no version of this where everyone gets what they want.
The right call and the easy call are rarely the same call.
consequence_texts: The ripples from that decision are reaching shore.
What we set in motion then is landing now.
The delayed consequence of week-past arrives.
Our earlier action has triggered a response.
Intelligence confirms: the chain of events continues.

victory_texts.DIPLOMATIC_VICTORY: Through patience, calculation, and an unwavering belief in structured dialogue, you prevented the unthinkable. The global crisis that should have consumed 2027 became instead a turning point—the year the world learned to step back from the edge. Your name will never appear in the history books. That was always the point.
victory_texts.INTELLIGENCE_SUPREMACY: Information became the architecture of peace. Your intelligence network, built operation by operation, became the invisible framework that held the world together. You knew before they moved. You understood before they understood themselves. History will record a series of fortunate coincidences. Only you know the truth.
victory_texts.PRAGMATIC_CONTROL: Not elegant. Not celebrated. But effective. You kept every resource above collapse threshold, every region from full crisis, every day from becoming the last day of the old order. The pragmatist's victory is never clean—but the world is still standing. In this business, that counts.

defeat_texts.RESOURCE_ZERO: The agency went dark. Without the operational capacity to function, the carefully constructed architecture of global stability collapsed. History records it as a cascading failure of institutions. Only the classified files—if they survive—will tell the true story of what was lost in this office.
defeat_texts.CRITICAL_REGIONS: Three simultaneous crises exceeded the agency's response capacity. The doctrine of managed instability failed its greatest test. Each region had its own logic, its own momentum—and when all three peaked at once, there was no lever left to pull. The world changed. We were not able to stop it.
defeat_texts.TURN_LIMIT: Thirty weeks. Thirty opportunities. In the end, the crisis outlasted our capacity to manage it. The resources drained, the alliances frayed, the threats converged. There is no shame in fighting until the end—but there is a lesson here, somewhere in the data, waiting to be found.
